title: D&G Stout: appellate allegations and later findings
shortTitle: D&G Stout: appellate allegations and later findings
summary: The editor’s account of the later trial adds facts and a different damages figure.
notes: The Seventh Circuit remanded a possible claim measured by the alleged $550,000 loss. The later court found that the assurance depended on continued sales performance and market conditions, yet allowed reliance damages of $394,050. This later outcome is an editorial report, not an additional holding on the page of the appellate opinion. The notes ask how its lost-opportunity award compares to earlier examples.
